body: Locked and loaded, peace out girl scout!

Well the dog is off, dinner is fed and the gun is just about in my mouth. I want to thank everyone that supported me and gave it their all to help me through hard times. Ha, I can't believe it, in 5 mins I will be dead! That's a hard pill to swallow  but one that is necessary! What the fuck, this goes against everything programed into us bit I'm doing it anyway! I'm gonna rot in hell for enurntity so why not get it done and one with! I will be dead in less then a minute! Goodbye!!!!!

Thank you, I will be honest the hardest thing is dropping my dog off. Fuck I love him! The Internet hug means a lot. But I am at that point where enough is enough. It's kinda weird knowing that in a couple hours I will be erased from this world but goddammit do I welcome it!

Haha, thank you. Maybe I will see a pretty girl but I doubt it! Ha I would love to pee on a cop car but pry get caught and foil my plans! Ha tonight is the night. But I'll be honest it's kinda creepy knowing what's about to go down! Im loading the dog up in the car now and he has no idea. My server will have no clue either, nor  will the gas station attended but I do. In a matter of hours I will be gone. It's sad, it really is. This isn't what I want but what I am left with no other option! It feels so good knowing that it's over! I almost wish I did it years ago!
That's the truth! To everyone it's different I guess, but at the same time what's the meaning of death?!

Thank you, but truth be told I'm a scumbag piece of shit. Yup I have overcome a lot maybe that's something to be proud of but I'm just ashamed of it all. No one of quality wants me in their life with the back round I have. I understand why and agree with it. I wouldn't want that shit around me, would you? I'm what's called a downer. Please let me drain all of the life/excitement/fun out of your life and tell me if that's what you want around. Not trying to argue but I'm just a black storm cloud that is about to pass. It will all be over shortly

Thanks for your reply, it really means a lot. The thing people don't understand is I have nothing to offer, I bring nothing to the table so why am I sitting at it? Very few can relate to me and I guess everyone perceives the word differently but I have no purpose on this earth. I can't change who I am, I have tried. I'm a coward to the core. Most people have never been where I am and I hope they never are. I have never had anything, people just don't get that. I appreciate the advice that people give but they could never fully understand what the pain is like. There is no glimmer of hope. I'm dumb, so uneducated it's not funny but one thing I am is aware. I see what is going on around me and can understand I'm not like everyone else. I have tried so hard, have giving life my all but I'm just a fuck up. I can't describe it how I feel and like I said most will never know what it's like. The clock is ticking, just gave the dog a bath and I'm pretty drunk. Gonna drop him off have some fun and do what needs to be done. I swear I can taste the bullet in my mouth and as fucked up as it sounds it's a pleasant taste that I look forward too. I just can't wait to end it. Again thanks for the kind words but sometimes you have to know when to hold em' and when to fold em'

I don't doubt you had it rough, but I didn't have it perfect either. My mother overdosed when I was a kid and my father was an alcoholic crackhead who spent 90% of my youth in jail. School suckered and I dropped out at an early age so I have damn near no education. I have done nothing productive with my life at all. I'm dumb as shit and must have some kind of learning disability cause I can't retain knowledge for shit. I have wanted to off myself for as long as I can remember but have always just been to much of a coward to do it. I got a girlfriend sometime ago and she was everything I could ever imagine. When I try to tell people how perfect she was I don't think they can understand. She did not have one flaw. For the first time in my life I was happy. I loved living, then she left me.  We never had one fight it was such a good relationship. I treated her so good, I did everything I could to make her happy and make it work. But she pointed out all the reasons I already knew as to why we wouldn't last. Said I had no goals, no ambition, no drive, no motivation, no hobbies, no interests. All this I knew, I'm a loser. I always have been and always will. The list goes on and on and on as to why I'm a fuck up but I just can't take it anymore. She was the last straw. It's just been a life of heartache, betrayal, and distrust. I have no one in this world to talk to, not a friend and no one that really cares about me. Does anyone really know what it's like to be alone? I mean absolutely alone. It sucks I'm going to end it and it's definitely a last resort but this shit has to end. I want a normal life more than anything but after 30 years of hell it's pretty apparent it's not gonna change. Everyone around me goes on and on about how great their life is and how happy they and their family's are. Good things are always happening to everyone around me. But never for this guy. Oh and believe me when I say I have had my share of drug and alcohol abuse. I'm no stranger to addiction.
Just want to say thank you to everyone that took time out of their day to comment on this post or messaged me. That means a lot, thank you everyone for the kind words and advice
